pages.text: With the recent studies comes a hypothesis, here I have constructed a series of machinery that will aid me in traveling to another realm. For the existence of this gem seems as though it wasn't grown here, but merely forced here by some series of events.
This here is one of the components I will need for crafting the gateway itself, I am going to need a bit of quartz it seems.

The most import part of the overall frame, the charger, this thing will ignite the portal via heat, creating so much molten within these impossibly cold blocks that matter itself will vibrate within the frame enough to cause a warp or a portal to materialize, this is the gateway to this alternate dimension.
Once the structure on the next page is built, I need to utilize a superheated version of the Liroth Gem, chucking it in a furnace should suffice then I but need to insert it into the charge frame.
Frame is to built as above
pages.name: The Liroth Portal
